description: Ivo Stannard has a debt he can't settle. He has tried to pay it eleven times and they won't take money from him, and he won't say why. He wants somebody who isn't him to carry a sealed box up the road, leave it at the gate, and bring the empty back. He was very clear that the box isn't to be opened, and then he was clear about it again, and then he apologised for being clear about it twice.
name: Nothing Owing

objectives.desc: Take the sealed box up the road and leave it at the gate.
emotes: {who} sets the box down in front of the gate and steps back off it.
{who} walks the box up a road with nobody on it and a wall at the end of it.
{who} doesn't open the box, and is aware for the whole walk of not opening it.

objectives.desc: Bring the empty back to Ivo Stannard at Last Requisition.
emotes: {who} comes back down the road with an empty box and nothing to report.
{who} hands the empty over and watches a man look at it for longer than an empty box needs.
